Butler.desc: ME system manager: keeps items stocked (autocraft), search-to-add on the computer, dashboard on a monitor

config.prompt: Seconds between stock checks
Monitor text scale (0.5 small, 1 normal, up to 5)
Seconds between re-fetching Butler.json from the repo (0 = off)

CrystalFeeder.desc: Crystal assemblers: load-balances whole sets over every assembler, then fills to Cap; processors -> provider

config.prompt: Buffer barrel peripheral name (auto = the only barrel on the network)
Pattern provider that takes the processors (auto = the only one on the network)
Most sets per assembler, a multiple of 4, reached only once every assembler has its share (8 = one batch running + one queued)

DE_Core.desc: Draconic energy core readout: stored energy and flow, broadcast for Butler's REACTOR tab

DE_Monitor.desc: Draconic reactor + energy core stats on a monitor, touch to switch (needs DE_Reactor / DE_Core running)

config.prompt: Monitor text scale (0.5 = most data)

DE_Reactor.desc: Draconic Evolution reactor control: holds temperature and field, auto start/stop, shuts down on trouble

config.prompt: Temperature to hold (8000 = most power before it wastes fuel)
Field % to hold (higher = safer, costs more input)
Shut down at this fuel conversion %
RF/t fed in while warming up
Flux gate feeding the injector (auto = found on the first charge)
Monitor text scale

Daylight.desc: Keeps it clear day: Environment Detector says night/rain/storm -> pulses every redstone relay, toggle in SKY tab

config.prompt: Seconds between pulses while still not clear day (the manipulator takes a while)

ME_Monitor.desc: Live ME dashboard on a monitor: storage, energy, cells, crafting CPUs, top items/fluids

config.prompt: Monitor text scale (0.5 = most data)
Seconds between refreshes
Seconds between full item/fluid/cell scans (0 = off, big networks stall the server)
What this computer's monitor shows (auto/dashboard/gauges)

Pocket.desc: Butler on a pocket computer: ME status, reactor, energy core and weather from anywhere (ender modem)

RS_ItemToRedstone.desc: Redstone out while an RS item is at/below a count

config.prompt: Item id to watch
Signal on when count is at or below
Redstone output side

RS_Trash.desc: Trash RS items above a keep count, or whole tags (list in RS_Trash.json)

config.prompt: Bridge side facing the trash

Weather.desc: Weather machine: fires DE celestial manipulators through redstone relays, local keys + Butler's SKY tab

cn_lib.desc: shared config helper (auto-installed as a dependency)

de_view.desc: reactor / energy core / weather screens for Butler, DE_Monitor and Pocket (auto-installed as a dependency)

reactor_rs.desc: RS Bridge pellet feeder, listens for reactor_sensor

config.prompt: Reactor name (same on sensor + RS computer)
Bridge side facing the fuel port
Pellet item id
Pellets per export
Craft when RS holds fewer than
Pellets per craft request

reactor_sensor.desc: Oritech reactor redstone port -> rednet gate broadcast

config.prompt: Reactor name (same on sensor + RS computer)
Side touching redstone port comparator
Gate opens (fuel allowed) when signal is below this, 1 = only when empty
